oh-nearer-my-god-to-thee-bethany.title: Nearer, My God, To Thee
oh-nearer-my-god-to-thee-bethany.artist: Sarah Fuller Flower Adams, Hervey Doddridge Ganse, Edward Henry Jr. Bickersteth
oh-nearer-my-god-to-thee-bethany.body:
Verse 1:
[G]Near[D7]er, my [C]God, to Thee,
[G]nearer to [D]Thee!
[G]E'en [D7]though it [C]be a cross
[G]that [D]raiseth [G]me,
Still [C]all my [G]song shall be,
near[C]er, my [D]God, to Thee.
[G]Near[D7]er, my [C]God, to Thee,
[G]Near[D]er to [G]Thee!

Verse 2:
[G]Though [D7]like the [C]wanderer,
[G]the sun gone [D]down,
[G]Dark[D7]ness be [C]over me,
[G]my [D]rest a [G]stone.
Yet [C]in my [G]dreams I'd be
near[C]er, my [D]God to Thee.
[G]5. Then [D7]ever[C]more to be
[G]Near[D]er to [G]Thee!

Verse 3:
[G]Near[D7]er, my [C]Lord, to thee,
[G]Nearer to [D]thee!
[G]Who [D7]to the [C]cross didst come,
[G]Dy[D]ing for [G]me!
Streng[C]then my [G]willing feet,
Hold [C]me in [D]service sweet

Verse 4:
[G]Near[D7]er, O [C]Comforter,
[G]Nearer to [D]thee!
[G]Who [D7]with my [C]loving Lord
[G]Dwel[D]lest with [G]me!

Help [C]me each [D]day to keep

Verse 5:
[G]But [D7]to be [C]nearer still,
[G]Bring me, O [D]God,
[G]Not [D7]by the [C]visioned steeps
[G]An[D]gels have [G]trod.
Here [C]where thy [G]cross I see,
Je[C]sus, I [D]wait for thee,

Verse 6:
There in my Father's home, safe and at rest,
There in my Savior's love, perfectly blest; Age
after age to be, nearer my God to Thee.

oh-no-not-one-no-not-one.title: No, Not One!
oh-no-not-one-no-not-one.body:
Verse 1:
[F]There's not a friend like the [Bb]lowly Jesus,
[F]No, not [C]one! [F]no, not one!
None else could heal all our [Bb]soul's diseases,
[F]No, not [C]one! [C7]no, not [F]one!

Refrain:
Jesus knows all about our struggles,
He will guide till the day is [C]done;
[F]There's not a friend like the [Bb]lowly Jesus,
[F]No, not [C]one! [C7]no, not [F]one!

Verse 2:
[F]No friend like Him is so [Bb]high and holy,
[F]No, not [C]one! [F]no, not one!
And yet no friend is so [Bb]meek and lowly,
[F]No, not [C]one! [C7]no, not [F]one!

Verse 3:
[F]There's not an hour that He [Bb]is not near us,
[F]No, not [C]one! [F]no, not one!
No night so dark but His [Bb]love can cheer us,
[F]No, not [C]one! [C7]no, not [F]one!

Verse 4:
[F]Did ever saint find this [Bb]friend forsake him?
[F]No, not [C]one! [F]no, not one!
Or sinner find that He [Bb]would not take him?
[F]No, not [C]one! [C7]no, not [F]one!

Verse 5:
[F]Was e'er a gift like the [Bb]Savior given?
[F]No, not [C]one! [F]no, not one!
Will He refuse us a [Bb]home in heaven?
[F]No, not [C]one! [C7]no, not [F]one!

oh-none-other-lamb-rossetti.title: None Other Lamb
oh-none-other-lamb-rossetti.body:
Verse 1:
[D]None [A7]other [D]Lamb, none [A7]other [D]name,

None other [D]hiding place from [A7]guilt and [F#7]shame,[Bm]

Verse 2:
[D]My [A7]faith burns [D]low, my [A7]hope burns [D]low;

Verse 3:
[D]Lord, [A7]Thou art [D]life, though [A7]I be [D]dead;

Nor Heav'n have [D]I, nor place to [A7]lay my [F#7]head,[Bm]

oh-not-worthy-lord-to-gather-up-the-crum.title: Not Worthy, Lord, to Gather Up the Crumbs

Verse 6:
My praise can only breathe itself in prayer,
My prayer can only lose itself in Thee;
Dwell Thou forever in my heart, and there,
Lord, let me sup with Thee; sup Thou with me.

oh-now-praise-we-christ-the-holy-one-chr.title: Now Praise We Christ, the Holy One

[Dm]Now praise [C]we [Dm]Christ, [G]the Holy [A]One,

[Dm]The grace [C]of [Dm]God, [G]th'Almighty [A]Lord,

a vir[F]gin [C]pure and [Am]undefiled

Verse 8:

oh-now-rest-beneath-nights-shadow-innsbr.title: Now Rest Beneath Night's Shadow
